paragraphs: SACS Software sells computer software for housing agencies, and the home page states that the products address the Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, Low Income Housing Tax Credit, Multifamily, and Rural Development programs. The home page groups that software into occupancy management, property management, financial management, and system management.

Document management covers electronic document storage, scanning of documents for storage, electronic signing, and reduced paper and storage costs. A tenant portal lists balance and current rent, contact updates, and work order submission.

Mobile applications listed on the page include work orders, inventory, inspections, excess utilities, occupant inquiry, and time clock. Web applications include an applicant portal, a tenant portal, a landlord portal, online application, and online payments.

quote.text: We offer products and services that uniquely address the needs of the Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, Low Income Housing Tax Credit, Multifamily, and Rural Development programs.
